subject: design/codegate-format-output
statement: The format check consumes the explicit StackDefaults.FormatOutputMode from ecosystem data. File-list mode fails on each nonblank stdout path; exit-status mode accepts successful informational stdout. Nonzero exits fail in both modes, and missing or unknown output modes fail closed.
intent: Allow additional stacks to declare formatter semantics without per-stack verification code.
rationale: The PR #1308 review reproduced a fourth stack returning zero while listing unformatted files; deciding semantics from the Go stack name would certify that formatter green and violate codegate A-1.
fit_criterion: Tests preserve Go file-list and Python exit-status behavior, switch one fourth stack between both output modes, reject incomplete or unknown modes, and inspect comparisons and switch cases for Go stack branches.

provenance.note: Replaces the unlanded Go-name decision to address discussion_r4119416985; bound to the exact proposed code.
